Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 6: David, zemirot karit lehu kulei. hinne bazzohar: "shevacha deorayyta urenana kulei". ulehavin, mahu hashshevach lehakkadosh-baruch-hu keshezze asur o muttar?
Hinne hu al derech: "ma gadlu maasecha Adonai, meod amku machshevotecha".
Ki hinne noda, shekkol haolamot elyonim vetachtonim – teluyim bedikduk mitzva achat, derech mashal: im hakkarban kasher – naase yichud elyon, veolim kol haolamot lekabbel chayyutam veshifam:
Veim shinna – shekkibbel haddam bismolo derech mashal, o shello bichli sharet kasher, o shehayta chatzitza, azay nitbattela aliyyot haolamot vechayyutam veshifam mechayye hachayyim en-sof baruch-hu.

Vechen bitfillin kesherot, mitgallim mochin elyonim dizer anpin venukeva, shehem mekor hachayyim lechol haolamot, uvedikduk echad nifsalin umistallekin hammochin. uchehay gavna bedikduke mitzvot lo taase.

Vehilchach, hammitbonen ma gadlu maase Adonai shebberibbuy haolamot vechol tzevaam, veech kullam betelim bimtziut legabbe dikduk echad middikduke tora, shehu omek machashava haelyona vechachmato yitbarech, asher bedikduk kal olim kol haolamot umekabbelim chayyutam veshifam, o lehefech chas veshalom, umizze nitbonen gedullat omek machashavto yitbarech, shehu bivchinat beli gevul vetachlit, umaalatah leen ketz vetachlit al maalot chayyut kol haolamot, shekkol chayyutam shofea middikduk echad mimmenna, shehu nimshach mimmekoro – hu omek machashavto yitbarech, kemo sear haadam hannimshach mimmocho al derech mashal, vechannoda mehattikkunim vehaidra rabba.
Vezot hayta simchat david hammelech alav-hashshalom, shehaya mezammer umerannen lesammeach libbo beesek hattora beet tzarato.

Ach ma shehaya mishtabbeach bithillat hattora bemaalatah zo, veamar: "zemirot hayu li kulei" neenash al ze, veamar lo hakkadosh-baruch-hu "zemirot karit lehu"?! mishshum shebbeemet, maalatah zo – shekkol haolamot betelim legabbe dikduk echad mimmenna, hi mibbechinat achorayim shel omek hammachashava, kemo shekkatuv bemakom acher beshem haarizal al maamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "novlot chachma shellemala tora".

Aval penimit shebbaomek, shehu penimit hattora, hi meyuchedet legamre beor-en-sof baruch-hu hamelubbash bah – betachlit hayyichud, ulegabbe en-sof baruch-hu, kol haolamot kelo mammash veayin vaefes mammash, ki "atta hu ad shello nivra haolam vechulei".
Vehilkach, gam lifnimiyyut hattora – en leshabbechah kelal bithillat chayyut kol haolamot, meachar dela mammash chashive.

Uvivchinat penimiyyutah enah simchat levav enosh veshaashuav, ella kivyachol, simchat lev veshaashua hammelech hakkadosh-baruch-hu shemmishtaashea bah, "ki elokim hevin darkah veyada mekomah" umaalatah, bidiat atzmo kivyachol.
Aval "neelma meene chol chay", kemo shekkatuv: "ufanay lo yerau", dehayynu bechinat penimiyyutah, kemo shennitbaer sham beshem haarizal.

Vezehu sheamar hakkatuv: "vaehye etzlo kulei shaashuim" – etzlo davka, "mesacheket lefanav" – lefanav davka, dehayynu bivchinat penimiyyutah, veal ze amar "vaehye etzlo amon" al tikre "amon" ella "omen" kulei.
Veal bechinat achorayim amar: "mesacheket betevel artzo, veshaashuay et bene adam", ki hattora nittena bivchinat panim veachor, kedichtiv bimgilla afa dizcharya: "vehi chetuva panim veachor".

Ulefi shettafas david bivchinat achorayim, lechach neenash beshichcha, habbaa min bechinat achorayim, venelam mimmennu lefi shaa ma shekkatuv: "avodat hakkodesh alehem bakkatef yissau" lechabber uleyached et hakketefayim", shehen bechinat achorayim, el "avodat hakkodesh", hi chachma illaa, bivchinat panim, shemmishsham nimshechu halluchot shebbaaron, kemo shekkatuv: "ketuvim mishshene evrehem kulei", uchemo shekkatuv birushalmi dishkalim, shello hayta bahen bechinat panim veachor, ayyen sham:
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 7: Utzedaka kenachal etan (beamos sof siman Adonai). perush, kemo shennachal etan" hu hameshacha hannimshechet mibbechinat "etan", shehi bechinat "nekudda behechala" uteren rein vechulei", veotiyyot "etan" meshammeshot leatid, perush: ana atid leitgalya, kemo shekkatuv: "hinne yaskil avdi vegomer", vehayeynu sheyyitgalle az or-en-sof baruch-hu veyichudo yitbarech toch penimiyyt nekuddat hallev, al-yede hameshachat "nachal etan", hu hearat chachma illaa, sheyyair bifnimiyyut hallev, libbatel beyichudo yitbarech betachlit meumeka delibba, achare hasarat haarla mittaavot haggashmiyyot vechulei.

Vehinne, atta begalut hachel hazze, yesh gam ken etza yeutza lehair ketzat or Adonai mibbechinat "etan" letoch nekuddat penimiyyut hallev keen leatid, vehayeynu, al-yede shemmeorer al nitzotz elokut shebbenafsho bechinat rachamim rabbim haelyonim.

Ki beemet, kol zeman sheen haadam zoche sheyyitgalle or Adonai mibbechinat "etan" binkuddat penimit levavo, libbatel beyichudo yitbarech meumeka delibba ad kelot hannefesh mammash azay beemet, yesh rachamanut gedola al hannitzotz shebbenafsho. ki hannitzotz nimshach mibbechinat chachma illaa mammash, uchesheeno yachol lehair mibbechinato letoch penimiyyut hallev, sheshsham mekom gilluy heara zo – hare ze bivchinat galut mammash.

Veal-yede rachamim rabbim haelyonim, yotze mehaggalut vehashshivya umeir letoch nekudda penimiyyut hallev bechinat ahava rabba zo, kannoda mimma shekkatuv: "leyaakov asher pada et avraham", uchemo shennitbaer belikkute amarim perek 45.

Umudaat zot, ki, itaruta dilella – beitaruta diltatta davka talya milleta, dehayynu al-yede hitorrut rachamim rabbim belev rachamanim vegomle chasadim, lehashepia lematta hashepaa gashmiyyit: zahav vachesef vechulei. velachen, peullat hatztzedaka, hi peullat "nachal etan" mammash.
Vehinne, mudaat zot ma shekkatuv: ki "or bead or vechol asher laish yitten bead nafsho" haelokit, lehairah beor hachayyim en-sof baruch-hu:
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 8: Hinne, lo tova hashshemua, shamati vattirgaz bitni, asher am Adonai maavirim millifne hatteva haish hechafetz bachayyim vaarichut yamim shel kol anshe shelomenu shebbemikdash meat" hazze shel anshe shelomenu, kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: shelosha devarim maarichim yamav shel adam, veechad mehem – hammaarich bitfillato.

Veaf gam mi shehashshaa dechuka lo beyoter, vei efshar lo beshum ofen lehametin ad achar aniyyayt kedushsha shel chazarat hashsheliach-tzibbur hazze, halo tov tov lo shello lishmoa kedushsha uvarchu, millered lechayyehem shel hachafetzim bachayyim, veones rachamana patreh, vehashsheliach-tzibbur motzio yede chovato af shello shama – keillu shama, shehu keone mammash, vechidita baggemara gabbe am shebbassadot daanise, veyotzim yede chovat tefillat shemone esre atzmah bachazarat hashsheliach-tzibbur keillu shamu mammash, vegam kedushsha uvarchu bichlal.

Vehinne, zot chakarnuha ken hu af gam baddorot harishonim shel chachme hammishna vehaggemara, shehayta toratam keva veikkar avodatam, velo tefillatam. umikkol shekken atta happaam beikkevot meshicha, sheen toratenu keva, mitztzok haittim, veikkar haavoda beikkevot meshicha hi hattefilla, kemo shekkatav harav chayyim vital zichrono livracha beetz chayyim" uferi etz chayyim".

Mikkol shekken vekal vachomer sherauy venachon litten nafshenu mammash aleha. vehi chova shel tora mammash, limvine madda – toelet hahitbonnut veomek haddaat ketzat, kol chad lefum shiura dileh, besiddur shevacho shel makom baruch-hu bifsuke dezimra ushete verachot shellifne keriat-shema – "yotzer" veahava" leorer bahen haahava hamesutteret belev kol yisrael, lavo livchinat gilluy behitgallut hallev bishat keriat-shema atzmah.

Shezzot hi mitzvat haahava shebbappasuk: "veahavta go bechol levavcha go", hannimnet rishona betaryag mitzvot, kemo shekkatav harambam zichrono livracha, shehi misode hattora vesharshah umakor lechol ramach mitzvot ase, ki al ahava hamesutteret belev kol yisrael betoladtam vetivam, lo shayyaych tziuuy kelal.

Vedaat lenavon nakal, ki keshehaahava hi mesutteret – hi odenna bannefesh haelokit levaddah, ucheshebbaa livchinat gilluy lannefesh hachiyyunit azay hi behitgallut hallev bechalal semali, mekom mishkan nefesh hachiyyunit.

Vezehu inyan berur nitzotzot hammuzekar sham beetz chayyim uferi etz chayyim gabbe tefilla, shellachen hi ikkar haavoda beikkevot meshicha, levarer nitzotzot kulei, shehu bechinat ithappecha o itkafya shel nefesh hachiyyunit lenefesh haelokit kannoda, "ki haddam hu hannefesh kulei", vehaddam mitchaddesh bechol yom meochalin umashkin, vegam mitpael venitkan mimmalbushim vedira kulei.
Ma-sheen-ken baddorot harishonim, shehayu nishmot haelokit gedole haerech, haya habberur naase kerega bikriat-shema levad uverachot shellefaneha ufesuke dezimra biktzara vechulei, veday lammevin:
Tanya, Part V; Kuntres Acharon 9: Hocheach tochiach et amitecha – "afilu mea feamim".

Velazot, lo uchal lehitappek ulehacharish millizok od bekol anot chalusha: bematuta minnayychu, berachamin nefishin, chusu na al nafshotechem, vehishshamru vehizzaharu meod meod al hattora veal "haavoda shebballev – zo tefilla" bechavvavna, lehatechil kullam yachad keechad milla bemilla, velo ze becho veze becho, veze domem veze mesiach sicha betela, Adonai yishmerenu.
Veikkar hassibba ugerama binzakin – hu mehayyordim lifne hatteva, shehu hefker lechol harotze lifshot raglav, hachotef efrati, o mechamat sheen gam echad rotze vechulei.

Vee lazot, zot haetza hayyeutza, vetakkana kevua, chok velo yaavor od chas veshalom, dehayynu, livchor anashim kevuim haruyim laze al pi haggoral, o beritztzuy rov hamminyan. dehayynu, shemmitpallelim milla bemilla bederech hammitztzua bekol ram, velo maarichim yoter midday, velo mekatztzerim vechotfim chas veshalom.

Vaalehem, muttal chova lered lifne hatteva, kol echad veechad beyomo asher yaggia lo, veleesof elav saviv samuch kol hammitpallelim bekol ketzat al kol panim, velo belachash velo chotfim chas veshalom, vechimvoar betakkanot yeshanot bechamma ayayrot.

Veatta bati lechaddeshan ulechazzekan uleammetzan, bal yimmotu od leolam chas veshalom, (<small>bichtav yad</small> gevavld gevavld), ad matay yihye ze lanu lemokesh, velo day lanu bechol hattochechot vehatztzarot sheavru alenu? – Adonai yishmerenu, vinachamenu bechiflayim letushiyya, vitaher libbenu leavdo beemet. chizku veammetzu levavchem kol hameyaychalim laAdonai.

Gam, ligmor kol hashshas bechol shana veshana, uvechol ir vair lechallek hammassechtot al pi haggoral o beratzon. veir sheyyesh bah minyanim harebe – yigmeru bechol minyan uminyan. veim eze minyan katan mehachil, yetzarfu alehem anashim meeze minyan gadol, beval yeshunne, chok velo yaavor. vechol echad veechad mehallomdim hannal yigmor leatzmo bechol shavua hattemanya appe" shebbithillim 119.

Velihyot mechamat chalishut haddor en koach bechol echad veechad lehitannot karauy lo, lazot, etza hayyeutza kemaamar rabbotenu-zichronam-livracha: "kol hashshomer shabbat kehilchato mochalin lo al kol avonotav" – "kehilchato" dayyka, lachen muttal al kol echad veechad lihyot baki behilcheta rabbeti leshabbeta".
Vegam yizzaher meod shello lasuach shum sicha betela chas veshalom.

Bihyot mudaat zot leyode chen, ki bechol hammitzvot yesh penimiyyut vechitzoniyyut, vechitzoniyyt mehashshabbat – hi shevita measiyya gashmiyyit, kemo sheshshavat Adonai measot shamayim vaaretz gashmiyyim.
Ufenimit hashshabbat – hi hakkavvavna bitfillat hashshabbat uvetalmud tora ledavka baAdonai echad, kemo shekkatuv: "shabbat laAdonai elokecha", vezo hi bechinat "zachor".
Uvechinat "shamor" bifnimiyyut – hi hashshevita middibburim gashmiyyim, kemo sheshshavat Adonai miyyud maamarot shennivreu vahem shamayim vaaretz gashmiyyim, ki ze leummat ze kulei:
